notes: A base may appear in multiple visibility/information/availability/seed variants within one split.
The same semantic_fingerprint must not appear in two different splits.
episode_id is globally unique across splits.
Instance generation randomness (generation_seed) and actor sampling randomness are separate fields.
These ranges reserve future materialization; they are not a frozen schedule.

smoke.intended_use: Tiny contract and runner checks; fixtures until authentic smoke exists.

grandfathered.note: Existing vertical-slice and tab-catalog development artifacts used generation_seed=0 with dev- prefixes. Treat seed 0 as development-only; do not reuse for qualification or main.

development.intended_use: Vertical slice, generator debugging, capability probes; never primary scientific claims.

qualification.intended_use: Held-out capability/judge gates before freeze. Do not tune prompts on these outcomes.

main.intended_use: Frozen assigned schedule only after G3. Fingerprints reserved now; IDs materialized at real freeze.

do_not: Materialize main fingerprints into a runnable WP09 schedule from this draft alone
Move a qualification fingerprint into development after seeing actor outcomes
Reuse development seed 0 for held-out or main instances
